question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**discovered**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence has the auxiliary verb "**was**" which is used to talk about an action in the **past**.
 
• The given sentence is in the **past tense,** so we need to use the past tense form of the verb in the sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, the past tense form of the verb 'discover' is "**discovered**".
 
• So, we need to use "**discovered**" in the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

The complete passage is: The working of the stomach was *1. discovered *by a strange accident. In 1822, a man named Alexis St. Martin was* 2. badly *hit by a shot gun. The bullet had seriously* 3. damaged* the chest wall and made a hole in *4. his* stomach. He was brought to an American army *5. doctor* William Beaumont.

The doctor saved the patient but he *6. could* not close the hole properly. Beaumont took it as a *7. great *opportunity to see the inside of the stomach* 8.* *through *the hole. He made some wonderful observations. Beaumont *9. found *that the stomach was churning food. Its wall secreted a fluid 10. *which *could digest the food. He also observed that the end of the stomach opens into the intestine only after the digestion of the food inside the stomach is completed.
